name: Admin Toolkit
overview: Admin-only dashboard toolkit: duplicates, artwork, library health and storage.
description: A Dashboard page for administrators with tabs for finding and resolving duplicate movies and shows (with a transparent keep/remove score and Sonarr/Radarr-aware removal), editing artwork with Jellyfin's providers or web image search (with real transparency detection), library health checks, storage insight per drive, and an activity log. Read-only by default: safe mode is on for a new install and every destructive action needs a preview and confirmation. No home-screen footprint and no changes to other plugins.
